item.title: Guterres: Old global order must change as power shifts to emerging economies
item.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres told leaders of a bloc of major emerging economies in New Delhi on Sunday that a more balanced global order requires an overhaul of the institutions built after the Second World War, including the UN Security Council.

item.title: Married at 13, pregnant and starving: Child brides of Yemen
item.description: Fatimah* was 13 when she was married off to an older man. Two years later, she gave birth to twin daughters.

item.title: An ‘Extended Opera’: Women’s Voices in the UN General Assembly Debate
item.description: Our new audio podcast “An 'Extended Opera': Women's Voices in the UN General Assembly Debate,” features excerpts from five speeches by world leaders who spoke at last year’s (UNGA80) UN General Assembly debate. The voices we’re highlighting are – in order of their “appearance” -- Mia Amor Mottley, prime minister of Barbados; Theresa Lazaro, foreign affairs minister of the Philippines; Thorgerdur Katrín Gunnarsdottir, foreign affairs minister of Iceland; Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah, president of Namibia; and Natasa Pirc Musar, president of Slovenia.
